_note: Successor provisional post-runtime-security-closure / pre-Qwen candidate. The historical fates-mvp-security-binding-2026-08-24.json and fates-lock.json remain unchanged.

ananke.role: authenticated source inspection and content-surface authority

mnemosyne.role: authenticated receipt verification and governed admission

horae.role: canonical lifecycle composition and exact-surface transport glue

moirae-code.role: session-owned Firecracker containment, constrained vsock, and credential custody

integration.role: tested pre-manifest Integration control/evidence checkpoint (non-recursive candidate identity)

securityBinding.trustedIssuerPolicy: Mnemosyne requires keyId -> Ed25519 public key, issuerRuntime=ananke, and an allowlisted issuer instance; audience.runtime=mnemosyne.
securityBinding.replayGuarantee: Admission consumes a single-use authenticated receipt by receipt digest/ID only, independent of caller-selected trustDomain; admission idempotency binds the complete operation identity including project, vault, trust, tenant, workspace, actor, candidate/source identity, and idempotency key. The ledger remains single-process in-memory with expiry sweep and a configurable bound; durable multi-process replay exclusion is not claimed.
securityBinding.effectiveConfigBinding: Session-owned jail staging writes canonical JSON, re-hashes the exact config file passed to jailer/Firecracker, verifies pinned staged artifact digests, and refuses ambient-config drift; live Linux guest execution remains unproven here.
securityBinding.credentialMode: Strict mode rejects InMemorySecretBroker and raw long-lived credential frames; only the production keyring-factory capability is eligible for OS-backed credential strategies.
